messages:
Priya: FYI — NovaEdge escalated, says retrieval + rerank quality dropped after last rollout. They included examples, saying citations gone and recall down. :rotating_light:
NovaEdge-CS: hi team — after your 2.3.0 rollout (deploy id rf-202), our 'support-articles' queries started returning fewer grounded answers. Example: 'How do I reset SSO keys?' used to return KB article link; now model hallucinates steps with no citation. Perf baseline dropped ~18% recall on our eval.
Priya: tagging @Ethan and @Lucas — they shipped the reranker tweak yesterday. Customer sample attached below. Request ID: req_0a9f34b2.
NovaEdge-CS: repro steps we ran: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"query":"How do I reset SSO keys?","top_k":10}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/retrieve` -> responses differ. We also have logs if needed.
deploy-bot: Deploy rf-202 -> prod completed 2023-11-21T15:12:30Z. Canary: 20%. Rollout policy: weighted-rerank-v2 enabled.
Maya: thanks — priority P1 for customer. Can someone confirm whether embedding model or reranker changed? Also need sample before/after responses (one or two prompts) for regression triage.
Priya: pasted the customer's before/after (they ran same prompt against snapshot and current):
---
Prompt: "How do I reset SSO keys for org-level SSO?"
Before (snapshot r-202-old):
Assistant: "You can reset SSO keys via Settings → Security → SSO Keys. See KB: https://novaedge.kb/reset-sso (article id 12345). Steps: 1) ... 2) ..."
After (prod rf-202):
Assistant: "To reset SSO keys, first go to your account settings and look for SSO. If you don't see it, contact support."  -- no KB link, inaccurate step about account-level vs org-level.
---
Ethan: that smells like the reranker scoring shift — weighted-rerank-v2 adjusted neural vs sparse weights. If neural score reduced relative to BM25, you can lose grounded anchors. Do we have the reranker config change diff?
Lucas: I approved the rerank tweak to favor latency/brevity yesterday; it included a lower context_similarity weight to speed up scoring. Noted in PR #342. Should have not impacted grounding that much though.
Priya: customer also shared quantitative: recall @k10 dropped 18% and citation precision down 22% on their test set after rf-202. They attached CSV with query_ids.
Ethan: can we get vector index version and embedding model used? If embeddings switched (e.g., embed-v3 -> embed-v3-quant), recall can change. Also need sampler/thresholds for reranker (mmr_k, diversity).
Priya: embedding model reported as emd-3.0 (same), index version idx_v14 (same). Reranker config diff: weighted-rerank-v2 enabled; param: context_similarity_weight 0.6 -> 0.35.
Ethan: that's likely the root — dropping similarity weight lets BM25 dominate; BM25 misses many KB anchors for paraphrased queries. Suggest immediate mitigation: revert context_similarity_weight to 0.6 for customer bucket or enable fallback to previous reranker variant.
Lucas: agree. I'll queue a rollback of weighted-rerank-v2 to previous config for the customer segment. Rollback window request: 30m.
Maya: I'll notify NovaEdge CS and request they re-run their eval once we flip the config. Also capture request_ids for failed examples. Priya — can you post a few failing request_ids and the timestamp?
Priya: posted request_ids: req_0a9f34b2, req_0b7c112d, req_0c1d9f00 — all between 2023-11-21T15:20:00Z and 15:28:00Z.
NovaEdge-CS: thanks — we can re-run after change. Our internal logs show missing citation URL field in the service response for those requests (field citations: []).
Ethan: adding a quick instrument: will run a rerank simulation locally on those query_ids and return score breakdown (BM25 score vs neural score + final rank). Expect to see neural score suppressed.
deploy-bot: Config flag weighted-rerank-v2 set -> false for segment novaedge-prod by Lucas @ 2023-11-21T16:02:10Z.
Lucas: completed rollback for the customer's segment. Monitoring now.
Maya: noted action items: 1) Confirm customer eval after rollback (owner: NovaEdge-CS). 2) Run A/B simulation to quantify impact of context_similarity_weight across corpora (owner: Ethan). 3) Add safety: when citation precision drop >10%, auto-suspend config rollout (owner: Lucas).
Ethan: I'll post score breakdowns in channel once sim runs (~30m).
Priya: I'll update the support ticket and ask NovaEdge to re-run. Thanks team :pray:
NovaEdge-CS: re-run in progress. We'll report back within the hour.
